        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=grid[0][0]
    # find pattern: cells != bg and != 0
    coords=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v not in (bg,0)]
    rs=[c[0] for c in coords]; cs=[c[1] for c in coords]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat=[[grid[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]

    z0,z1,zz0,zz1=min(zr),max(zr),min(zcc),max(zcc)
    for i,row in enumerate(flipped):

    return g
